name: quasigroup_idempotent_n7_seed20605__v20
prompt:
Construct a quasigroup of order 7 satisfying QG3 idempotence and the involution property. Specifically: an n×n grid x with values in {0, ..., 6} such that:
  - Every row and every column is a permutation of 0..6 (Latin square)
  - x[i][i] = i for all i in [0, 7) (idempotent diagonal)
  - x[ x[i][j] ][ x[j][i] ] = i for all i, j in [0, 7) (QG3)
The third constraint involves nested indexing (the indices themselves are values from x). For n in [5, 12], few solutions exist and search is non-trivial.

Return the grid as a flat list of 49 integers in row-major order (cell (i,j) at index i*7+j), or state "UNSATISFIABLE".
